section.6: The Book of the Times (of Prayer)

6.name_native: The Book of the Times (of Prayer)

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:"Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it, for Allah says: and perform the Salah for My remembrance." [1] [1] Ta-Ha 20:
